EC1: Previous or concurrent hormonal management [AND] of prostate cancer
EC4: Considered as a candidate for curative therapy
EC5: History of severe untreated asthma [OR], anaphylactic reactions [OR] or severe urticaria [OR] and/or angioedema
EC6: QTc interval over 450 msec  [OR] or risk factors for torsades de pointes [OR] or on Class IA [OR] and Class III anti arrhythmic medications
EC7: Cancer within the last 5 years [NOT] except prostate cancer [AND] and surgically removed basal [OR] or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin
EC8: Known or suspected hepatic [OR], symptomatic biliary disease (this includes moderate to severe chronic hepatic impairment)
EC9: Patients with clinically significant laboratory abnormalities [OR]/ disorders other than prostate cancer
EC10: Patient with Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) [OR], Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) [OR] and Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infections
